translations.web: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
translations.bsb: May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.
translations.kjv: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
translations.asv: Let the lying lips be dumb, Which speak against the righteous insolently, With pride and contempt.
